def setup_net_and_wire(lib, cell, net_name, wire_points, wire_label):
    import pyAether as pyScript
    cv = pyScript.dbOpenCV(lib=lib, cell=cell, view="schematic")
    net = pyScript.dbCrtNet(cv=cv, name=net_name)
    wire_figs = pyScript.dbCrtSchWire(cv=cv, point=wire_points)
    if wire_figs:
        pyScript.dbCrtSchWireName(cv=cv, wire=wire_figs[0],
                                  name=wire_label,
                                  point=wire_points[0])
    return net
